description: React component for the authentication panel allowing users to choose between OAuth and API token authentication methods, along with related UI elements.

methods.name: AuthPanel
methods.description: Main React functional component for the authentication panel, providing UI for OAuth and API token authentication.

methods.name: handleOAuthAuthenticate
methods.description: Handles OAuth authentication initiation by invoking onAuthenticate with 'oauth'.

methods.name: handleAPITokenAuthenticate
methods.description: Handles API token authentication by invoking onAuthenticate with 'api-token' and provided credentials.
